$about: Flag assets sourced by hand, keyed by the filename used in public/flags.
The build prefers these over the flag-icons asset of the same name, and
generates public/flags/CREDITS.md from the licence fields below (plan §3.2,
T0.4). Every entry must record where the file came from and under what
licence — an asset without provenance does not ship.

sh.author: Patricia Fidi
sh.reason: flag-icons ships the plain Union Jack under the code `sh`. Saint Helena's flag is a Blue Ensign carrying the territory's shield, so the flag-icons asset would have shown the wrong flag and made it indistinguishable from the United Kingdom.
